data.gender_notes: Muzaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'muzun', meaning 'firm, determined, or steadfast'. The name Muzaina is a feminine variation of this word, reflecting the strength and resilience associated with it in Islamic tradition. The name Muzaina carries the meaning “Determined, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzaina usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzaina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
